answer: A burst of registrations therefore prices itself out, because the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The mesa multiplier is published, charged in dawn, and ledge lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 6 for every participant already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. A farm of 3344 identities would post 2889 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
